verdict.stopBranchCondition1: Not met: the freeze is present on the non-synced control (7237 ms) and on the swapped-order synced run (7093 ms); first-launch warm-up is not the cause.
verdict.stopBranchCondition2: Top self time is three.js matrix math under applyAndPlantSupineDeck; call site apps/ui-xr/src/main.ts:2682, executing code in packages/openclinxr/xr-pose. Outside xr-sync-client; borderline against the card's roots wording (call site inside apps/ui-xr).
verdict.result: attributed: a 7.1-7.4 s main-thread script_eval in the shell supine-deck plant, independent of encounter sync. A fix card belongs to xr-pose / ui-xr, not xr-sync.
verdict.knownGoodForFixBound: No heartbeat gap > 250 ms at either rotation in any run; the only later gaps are 276-282 ms immediately after the freeze (v2syn-1, v2ctl-1).
